title: Add deliberate peek and eavesdrop way reconnaissance actions over beyond_visibility.py and sound.py

sections.what: Add intentional peek <way> and eavesdrop <way> reconnaissance actions built on engine/beyond_visibility.py and engine/sound.py so characters can scout through cracked doors/windows or listen closely at closed barriers without barging into an area.
sections.why: engine/beyond_visibility.py (lines 55-260) and engine/sound.py (lines 69-165) only apply passive beyond-door sightlines on see_through/open ways and passive sound attenuation across closed barriers. Characters have no intentional stealth verb to check what is happening behind a closed door or corner before entering.
sections.how: 1. Extend engine/beyond_visibility.py with a targeted peek_way(graph, player_manager, area_id, way_handle, actor) helper checking see_through/window/cracked/open door eligibility and resolving occupant notice checks.\n2. Extend engine/sound.py / routes/action_handlers.py with eavesdrop_way(world, actor, way_handle) that focuses listening across that single barrier (temporarily attenuating get_way_barrier resistance by focus/Perception bonus against recent/ongoing speech and sound sources beyond the barrier).\n3. Register peek and eavesdrop in engine/action_registry.py, PlanGrounding.PLAN_INTENT_ACTS, routes/action_handlers.py, and contextual-actions.ts.
sections.verify: 1. Run pytest verifying peek <way> respects sealed vs cracked/windowed barriers + stealth spotting, and eavesdrop <way> captures adjacent room speech/sounds while failing on soundproof barriers.

acceptance.text: peek <way> and eavesdrop <way> are registered in engine/action_registry.py, PlanGrounding, routes/action_handlers.py, and contextual-actions.ts for adjacent closed/crackable/windowed ways.

peek <way> queries adjacent area contents via engine/beyond_visibility.py (without physically moving or opening the door wide) and rolls stealth vs occupant Perception to decide whether the peek is noticed.
eavesdrop <way> performs a focused acoustic check via engine/sound.py (reducing the barrier threshold across that single way for active listening without leaking through sealed/soundproof walls).

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Agent Turn Modal exit brackets (`peek <way>`, `eavesdrop <way>`) and Event Stream perception output.

Current availability: engine/beyond_visibility.py (sightline_run, build_beyond_suffix) and engine/sound.py (propagate_sound, get_way_barrier) run only passively during look/speech; no deliberate peek or eavesdrop verbs exist.

Manual verification steps:
1. Stand beside a closed door with characters talking inside the adjacent area and run `eavesdrop <way>` then `peek <way>`.
   - expected: eavesdrop captures muffled speech/activity through closed doors, and peek surfaces immediate beyond-door entities if crackable/windowed (with stealth detection risk).
